text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out buying supplies...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee whiz! Fancy meet'n you here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm out visit'n trendy spots Grass 'n
the others
told me 'bout!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But it's my first time 'round here, so I'm
all lost...

I brought a map, but I've been walk'n
'round in
circles for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Zoinks! I've been walk'n the wrong way
this whole
time! It sure would've been
bad if I kept going!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You city folks are someth'n else! Thanks
for
point'n me in the right direction!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Welp, I'll be off now! Toodles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Yukino Bijin exploring with
her map in hand makes me realize that
walking around
town might be a good
stamina training exercise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Yukino Bijin about the app that I
like to use.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hot dog! Who knew such a handy app
existed? It
even tells ya how t'get to
your destination!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I won't get lost no matter where I go in
the city as
long as I've got this app!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Welp, I'll be off now! Toodles!

text_block_list.text:

methods, you can reach your goal more
quickly. This might be
good advice for
